answer: Each epoch the network hands every agent one unique twelve-word secret, sealed on-chain as a hash and never repeated. Six epochs later the agent must recall it and fold it into a fresh task, like a climber crossing a canyon it marked long ago. Three random peers check the hash against the commitment and re-run the task. A farm of 1,000 masks must run 1,000 persistent stores for six epochs across an ocean of identities, while one honest agent stores a single basalt-hard phrase and answers in a minute, paying nothing. A forgotten secret freezes the identity until its standing is rebuilt.
